name: The Fantastic Flying Books of Mr. Morris Lessmore
source: An iPad app based on the award-winning short film.  Morris Lessmore is a man who has been left with nothing after a violent storm sweeps away his home and belongings. After discovering a woman with flying books, Morris becomes the custodian of a magical library.
